desc: Derive and document the per-number cost c(x) and prove the query answer is max(ceil(total / 2), mx).
Implement prefix-sum helper F(n) using precomputed powers of 4 to compute sum of c(x) for x in [1, n].
Implement minOperations to compute total = F(r)-F(l-1), mx = c(r), result = max((total+1)//2, mx), and sum all results using Python integers.
Test the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases such as ranges crossing powers of 4, n = 0, and very large ranges.
